entities.name: Tresserhorn Keep
entities.description: Lim-Dûl's fortress on Terisiare during the Ice Age, later held by the Knights of Stromgald and destroyed by the New Argive army.

entities.name: Lord of Tresserhorn
entities.description: A copy of Lim-Dûl created by Chaeska, destroyed by Jodah and Jaya.

entities.name: Haakon
entities.description: Unliving leader of the Knights of Stromgald, killed in the Battle of Kjeldor.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Returned to Tresserhorn in 2954 AR and destroyed the Lord of Tresserhorn.

entities.name: Heidar
entities.description: Rimewind leader who convinced Haakon to ally.

entities.name: Order of Stromgald
entities.description: Undead knights who besieged and then took over Tresserhorn.

entities.name: New Argive army
entities.description: Army that marched on and destroyed Tresserhorn.

entities.name: Battle of Kjeldor
entities.description: Battle in which Haakon was killed.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent on Dominaria where the keep stood.

events.summary: Chaeska builds Tresserhorn twenty years after the Ice Age begins.
events.quote: Tresserhorn was built by Chaeska , Keeper of Tresserhorn, twenty years after the Ice Age's onset.

events.summary: The Order of Stromgald besieges Tresserhorn for twenty years in a stalemate.
events.quote: For twenty years, a stalemate held

events.summary: Jodah and Jaya return in 2954 AR and destroy the Lord of Tresserhorn.
events.quote: But Jodah and Jaya returned there in 2954 AR , and destroyed the Lord of Tresserhorn.

events.summary: The Knights of Stromgald overpower Chaeska and take over Tresserhorn under Haakon.
events.quote: The Knights of Stromgald eventually overpowered Chaeska and his skeletal guard

events.summary: Heidar visits and convinces Haakon to ally.
Haakon marches to Kjeld and is killed in the Battle of Kjeldor.
events.quote: was held back and killed in the Battle of Kjeldor

events.summary: The New Argive army destroys Tresserhorn, leaving its ruins to the Sea of Laments.

relations.quote: But Jodah and Jaya returned there in 2954 AR , and destroyed the Lord of Tresserhorn.
